text:
ashley: Heads-up — nightly eval failing on policyQA promptset after latest int8 bring-up. Overall pass rate down 18% vs baseline. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/nightly/2097654321

ashley: Quick summary:
- model: redwood-opt-1.3b-int8 (new packed-kv kernel)
- affected suite: policyQA (safety + alignment prompts), reranker + final-answer stage
- symptom: label flips + hallucinated 'unsupported action' for specific prompts
- first seen: 2026-03-19 03:12 UTC (nightly run)

kai: Ugh. any diffs in tokenization or prompt formatting between runs?

ashley: We diffed a sample subset. No prompt truncation. But noticed token boundary counts changed for ~6% of samples (likely merge table update from tokenizer v2).

miles: Also saw shifted KV cache hit patterns in trace logs — more frequent cache eviction in early layers when using packed-kv kernel. Could be interaction with new quant rounding.

ashley: Attaching relevant snippets from the run log:
```
[2026-03-19 03:11:42] eval: sample_id=polqa-442 diff_tokens=+2
[2026-03-19 03:11:42] trace: layer3:kvcache.evictions=7 -> baseline 2
[2026-03-19 03:11:42] quant: avg_scale_layer3=0.023 vs baseline 0.019
```

eva: The avg_scale bump can amplify quantization bias for rare tokens. If tokenizer merges alter token distribution, the per-channel scale calibration may be off.

kai: Can you paste the quant calibration command used for the build?

ashley: We ran:
```
python infra/calibrate.py --model redwood-opt-1.3b --quant int8 --calib-samples 2048 --per-channel
```
No change from standard pipeline.

miles: Hypothesis: tokenizer merge -> changed token frequency -> different activation stats -> new per-channel scales -> packed-kv kernel rounding interacts with scale offset -> small logits shift -> reranker flips.

canary-bot: deploy-event: canary deploy started for service: inference-v2, tag: int8-packedkv-20260318, traffic: 0%

ashley: Immediate actions proposed:
1) Rollback inference cluster to previous int8 kernel (packedkv-v1) for policyQA critical orgs. (rollback window: 30m)
2) Pause rollout for packed-kv kernel globally until triage complete.
3) Add a gating rule: nightly eval drop >5% on policyQA or safety suites blocks pipeline.
4) Add a tiny fuzz test to nightly that reruns 500 critical prompts through quant-calibrated path and checks top1 agreement >= 94%.

kai: I'll take kernel alignment and low-level repros. Plan: run per-layer activation histogram compare between packedkv and v1, and run calibration with an augmented tokenizer-aware sample set. ETA 6h.

miles: I'll expand the promptset to include the token-boundary-sensitive cases and add a metric that tracks KV-eviction counts per sample; add to nightly dashboard. ETA 24h.

ashley: I'll coordinate rollback and notify SRE to pin traffic for affected customers. Also filing a gating PR: infra/ci/gates#314

canary-bot: deploy-event: canary deploy aborted (reason: nightly-gate failed)

eva: Longer-term mitigation: consider per-workload calibration (calib pools sampled from same tokenizer + prompt distribution) and tolerate small tokenizer changes by smoothing per-channel scales with exponential prior.

kai: Also testing a quick patch: after calibration, run a second-pass scale refinement using 256 in-distribution samples and adjust scales if mean-logit shift > 0.01. If that reduces flips we can avoid full rollback.

ashley: Decision log:
- Immediate: pause packed-kv rollout, rollback critical clusters to packedkv-v1 (actioned).
- Guardrail: add nightly gating rule and fuzz test (PR opened).
- Owners: kai (low-level repro & kernel fix), miles (eval expansion & dashboard), ashley (coordinator + rollback), eva (calibration strategy).

ashley: I'll post a short root-cause doc in 2-3 hrs with repro steps and sample artifacts.

miles: Thanks — leaving notes for oncall in case further alerts come in. :thumbsup:

kai: starting prv-level traces now. ping me @kai if you have logs to add.

ashley: Closing thread for immediate coordination. Will reopen when RCA doc is published.
